priorities.summary: Opt-in sidecar-owned durable process stdin/stdout/stderr reattaches across native-agent restart; bounded output spool and Windows/Linux CI coverage
Task-graph artifact metadata/hashes persist without contents; bounded list and re-verification primitives detect verified/changed/missing/unverified/error states
Persistent device directory, aliases, groups, capability-aware discovery, deterministic named route policies, and multi-device routing are implemented

Native protocol v2 identifies process instances; same-process reconnects resume exact request IDs through bounded dedupe cache, read-only work may resume after process restart, and pending mutations fail unknown instead of replaying across instance change
First-party relay server, ordered direct/relay endpoint fallback, inbound/upstream authentication, bounded forwarding/backpressure/heartbeats, and real native-agent relay CI are implemented
Per-device capability policies, a separate elevated Windows broker, DPAPI CurrentUser-protected broker authentication, and highest-privilege per-user scheduled-task lifecycle are implemented

Direct TLS, rotating bootstrap bearers, revocable/expiring hash-only credentials, role/tool/device/route scopes, Windows DPAPI envelopes, external OIDC/JWT identity, and Linux Secret Service/macOS Keychain protected-secret adapters wired into hub/agent/relay bootstrap are implemented; deployment onboarding/revocation policy and remaining platform-store hardening remain
Stored credential authorization filters tools/list and calls, and HTTP MCP discovery also filters native-backed schemas by the union of capabilities advertised by online Nexowire agents
Reusable bounded read-only file/process/TCP/HTTP postcondition assertion workflows are implemented
Real Linux native-agent outbound transport/core capability and real relay fallback integration run in Ubuntu CI; real WSL2 distro integration remains open
Bounded persistent payload-free audit history query with capability/status/target/provider/operation/time filters

Higher-level durable runbooks now compose persistent task-graph and read-only assertion stages with dependency DAGs, bounded parallelism, payload-free checkpoints, exact-spec resume, safe automatic replay of interrupted read-only assertions, and explicit retry for unknown task state

MCP surface v1 has a stable tool-name floor, frozen backward-compatible input contracts, and a machine-readable frozen structured-output semantic contract with canonical hash and surface discovery metadata

Manifest v1, validation, policy metadata, exact-device runnability, and 38 shipped operational workflows including specialized diagnostics/recovery v3 are implemented; manifest/version evolution and additional domain recipes remain incremental work

notes: Use independent branches/worktrees for parallel slices.
Update this file after major merges that materially change remaining work.
Do not infer completion from chat history; inspect main and CI.
The first-party relay path is verified with a real native agent in Ubuntu CI.
Development access through SentinelX/RDC is temporary tooling only and never counts as runtime implementation.
Durable runbooks are the preferred higher-level orchestration primitive; do not add new step kinds unless restart/replay semantics are explicit and tested.
MCP surface v1 is the compatibility floor; additive tools are allowed, but stable tool removal/rename requires a new surface version and migration path.
Shipped skills declare platform/mutation/privilege/trust/tags; skills_list can evaluate missing capabilities against an exact online device.
Stable v1 input schemas are frozen in src/mcp/v1-input-contract.json; regenerate only after explicit compatibility review.
Shipped skill manifests are CI-validated as a library contract.
npm run continuation:check validates PROJECT_STATE.json, required continuation files, hot-file references, unique/sorted priorities, and the HANDOFF resume contract.
Stable v1 structured-output semantics are frozen in src/mcp/v1-output-contract.json; regenerate only after explicit compatibility review.
OIDC/JWT external MCP identity is merged and maps into existing Nexowire role/tool/device/route authorization; do not treat it as active unfinished work.

Linux Secret Service and macOS Keychain protected-secret adapters are merged and bootstrap lookup is wired into hub/native-agent/relay configuration; macOS safe non-argv write remains intentionally fail-closed.
Specialized skill pack v3 is merged; shipped operational skill count is 38.
